title: Toddler in Sailor Cap, Seated on Car Hood - Vintage 1950s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid snapshot of a young child or toddler seated on the hood of an automobile parked outside a suburban home or garage. The toddler wears a light-colored outfit with a matching white sailor-style cap tilted on curly hair, smiling off-camera in the bright daylight. A classic late-1940s or early-1950s split-windshield car with an exterior spotlight and wooden siding of an adjacent garage structure frame the background, evoking post-war American suburban domestic life.
